svg.title: Satori monitor: cron tick, curl check, failed assert, Slack alert
svg.desc: A 16-second loop. The playbook monitor.yml defines a monitor named Website Check with cron "*/5 * * * *", image curlimages/curl:7.83.1, a settings.notify rule result: fail, to: slack, and a test that runs curl -is https://satori.ci with assertStdoutContains HTTP/2 200 and Satori CI. A schedule strip counts down to the next run; the 12:05 UTC cron tick reaches now and fires. The run starts: curl connects and returns HTTP/2 503 Service Unavailable. Both asserts, assertStdoutContains HTTP/2 200 and Satori CI, fail and the run is marked FAILED. A Slack notification from Satori CI in #alerts arrives: Website Check failed, 2 failing asserts, assertStdoutContains: HTTP/2 200, with report link dashboard.satori.ci/reports/90518. The next run is in 5:00, at 12:10 UTC. Caption: Schedule. Check. Alert. A monitor is a playbook that runs on a cron or rate.

g.text: waiting for the next cron tick…

svg.text: A monitor is a playbook that runs on a cron or rate.
